note: API-representation adapter only. All semantic content (question keys, instructions, scope sentences, policy sentence, choice values+descriptions, score level labels+descriptions, order) is read at runtime from the frozen P1 file below. Nothing here adds, removes or rewords a question, choice or level. Written before any Clef call on benchmark items.

representation.question_id: identical to the P1 question name (single: <key>; attention: cam01_<key>, cam02_<key>, cam03_<key>, attention_first; multi_camera: <key>) - all satisfy the Clef id rule [A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,100}
representation.question_order: identical to the P1 question list order (JSON object insertion order)
representation.instructions: identical string to P1: '<scope sentence> <question instructions> <policy>' stripped
representation.noul: P1 predicate had no yes/no descriptions; Clef optional 'criteria' is omitted
representation.choice: P1 choices [{value, description}] -> Clef criteria object {value: description}, same order; attention_first choices filtered to supplied cameras + no_clear_priority exactly as in P1
representation.score: P1 levels [{label, description}] -> Clef criteria array [{label, description}], same order, lowest first (index 0 = first P1 level)

answer_normalization.choice: {type:'choice', choice, probabilities:{value:p}, confidence} -> {type:'choice', name, choice, confidence, probabilities:[{value, probability}] in criteria order}
answer_normalization.score: {type:'score', score, legend, probabilities:{level_key:p}, confidence} -> {type:'score', name, score, confidence, probabilities:[{label, value:index, probability}] in level order}
answer_normalization.missing_or_invalid: an absent or schema-invalid answer becomes {type:'refusal', name} so that the frozen P1 refusal path (unknown decision, lowered confidence, forced human review) applies unchanged; Clef defines no refusal answer type
